transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been struggling with a deeply depressed and sad mood for over a year now, for about 14 months. It just feels like a constant, heavy cloud that I can't seem to shake off.
During these 14 months, have there been any periods lasting 2 months or more when your mood felt mostly back to normal? Or has the depression been present nearly every day the whole time?
No, I haven't had any periods where my mood went back to normal for that long. It has really been present pretty much every single day for the entire 14 months without any break.

During this time, have there been periods lasting at least 2 weeks when, along with feeling depressed, you also had several other symptoms like major loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, guilt, or thoughts of death? If so, did those symptoms cluster together during the same 2-week period?

Yes, absolutely, those symptoms have been clustered together for almost the entire 14 months. During this time, I've had a persistent depressed mood, a complete loss of interest in things I used to enjoy, changes in my appetite, and recurrent thoughts of death. It has all been happening at the same time without any relief.

Before this 14-month period, had you already been feeling chronically depressed for at least 2 years, or did this depression begin more abruptly about 14 months ago? In other words, was there a long-standing low mood before this episode started?
I don't recall having a long-standing, chronic low mood for years before this. The depression really seemed to start about 14 months ago.
Since this began 14 months ago, how much has it affected your daily functioning, like work, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

It has severely impacted my life because I've lost all motivation to do my work and find it incredibly hard to care about my achievements anymore. I've also completely withdrawn from my friends and social relationships, barely keeping in touch with anyone. Just trying to manage basic daily tasks feels nearly impossible.
You mentioned recurrent thoughts of death—have you had any thoughts of killing yourself, or made any plans or attempts?

Yes, it has gone beyond just wishing I wouldn't wake up. I've had active thoughts of wanting to kill myself and sudden, strong impulses to do things like jump from a high place. I've even made specific plans and started hoarding pills to end my life.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a 14-month depressive episode with persistent depressed mood, marked anhedonia, appetite change, recurrent thoughts of death, active suicidal ideation with plan and preparatory behavior, and severe functional impairment. The episode has been continuous without remission, and there is no history suggesting chronic depressive symptoms predating the episode, making Persistent Depressive Disorder less likely.
